proposal.thesis: Buy the SPY 2026-08-21 640/650 call debit spread, two units at the 4.55 mid (net bid 4.25 / ask 4.85): 910.00 USD of defined risk, 0.9% of the 100,000.00 USD equity, for a maximum profit of 1,090.00 USD if SPY closes above 650 at expiry. Breakeven is 644.55, 0.9% above the 638.75 spot, with 22 days for the post-Fed drift toward the 641.20 high to continue. Net delta is about 40 share-equivalents per unit and theta is small at 22 DTE. The mid is chosen because the quotes are 47s old and the legs are 0.30 wide; paying up to the ask is not needed.
proposal.invalidation: A daily close below 630 before 2026-08-14, or a close below 636 (the spread's midpoint loss level) on the day after the next FOMC statement.
